desc:
🏦 Welcome to Steal A Vault!

How to Play:
🔓 Steal vaults from banks
👮 Outrun the guards to escape
💎 Open vaults to collect rare loot
💰 Earn money from your loot
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
✨ Discover rarer vaults, loot, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
